note: Iteration 114, the BFSP plan of 10 Nov (reports/bfsp_model_plan.md), steps 1 and 4: the wide measuring stick and the market rating. The served main's features (the 14 served blocks) on the quick recipe, scored walk-forward from 30 Sep 2023 to 31 Mar 2026 (about 11 folds of 91 days) instead of two, with two controls: a placebo block of noise and the same base at seed 7, which together set the bar a block must clear on this window. Against them, the market rating block (mr_: every past Betfair SP read as a share of a multinomial logit whose race level comes from the rivals' ratings, Kalman-filtered by horse and pool). Decides: the noise bar for the wide window; the market rating goes on to the served recipe if it beats the base by more than both controls move it, on the price and on the closing score.
